clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各地区的实付销售额，按销售额从高到低排列
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT region AS 地区, SUM(paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各客户等级的实付销售额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_level AS 客户等级, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level

clear_cases.query: 查询2026年8月实付销售额最高的5个产品及其销售额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS 产品, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月已支付订单的数量
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS 已支付订单数 FROM orders_current WHERE status = '已支付' AND order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01'

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各产品类别的平均订单金额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT category AS 产品类别, AVG(order_amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY category

clear_cases.query: 查询2026年8月实付销售额超过50000元的客户名称和销售额，按销售额降序
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name AS 客户名称, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_name HAVING SUM(o.paid_amount) > 50000 ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各订单状态的订单数和实付金额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT status AS 订单状态, COUNT(order_id) AS 订单数, SUM(paid_amount) AS 实付金额 FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY status

clear_cases.query: 对比2026年7月和8月的实付销售额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT 月份, SUM(实付金额) AS 销售额 FROM (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, paid_amount AS 实付金额 FROM orders_history WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01' UNION ALL SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, paid_amount AS 实付金额 FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01') t GROUP BY 月份

clear_cases.query: 列出2026年8月各地区销售负责人、销售目标和实际实付销售额
clear_cases.gold_sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT region, SUM(paid_amount) AS actual_amount FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region) SELECT s.region AS 地区, s.owner_name AS 负责人, s.target_amount AS 销售目标, a.actual_amount AS 实际销售额 FROM sales_targets s JOIN actual a ON s.region = a.region WHERE s.target_month = '2026-08'

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月战略客户的实付销售额总和
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 战略客户销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_level = '战略客户' AND o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01'
